source: MOCK API for the SOS Safety System academic project. Sample content, not official safety guidance.

tips.title: Share your plans
tips.body: Tell a trusted person where you are going and when you expect to arrive.

tips.title: Stay aware of your surroundings
tips.body: Keep your phone and headphones low when walking alone, especially after dark.

tips.title: Trust your instincts
tips.body: If a place or person makes you uneasy, move to a busy, well-lit area and ask for help.

tips.title: Use licensed transport
tips.body: Check the vehicle details before getting in, and share your trip details with a contact.

tips.title: Keep copies of documents
tips.body: Store photos of your ID and tickets separately from the originals.

tips.title: Charge your phone
tips.body: Carry a power bank on long trips so you can always reach your contacts.

tips.title: Know your local emergency number
tips.body: Learn the emergency number for your country and keep your contacts up to date.

tips.title: Prepare a basic kit
tips.body: Keep a small kit with a torch, first-aid items, water and important phone numbers on paper.

tips.title: Practise your plan
tips.body: Agree on a meeting place with family and rehearse what to do in an emergency.
